title: #188 Better Parents
prompt: Some say mothers are better parents than fathers. What is your opinion?

promptSegments.text: Some say mothers are better parents than fathers.

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.
requirements.vi: Hỗ trợ quan điểm bằng hai lý do rõ ràng.

requirements.en: Use relevant examples when they strengthen an idea.
requirements.vi: Dùng ví dụ phù hợp khi chúng làm rõ ý.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Mothers build a strong connection and take on much responsibility in the family.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Mothers build a strong connection and take on much responsibility in the family.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Mothers take the main role in the home and provide strong emotional support.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Mothers take the main role in the home and provide strong emotional support.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Fathers are important parents because they teach practical skills and provide support in daily life.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Fathers are important parents because they teach practical skills and provide support in daily life.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The roles of both parents are equally important for a child's development.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The roles of both parents are equally important for a child's development.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Mothers possess a unique emotional ability to connect with their children, providing deep security and comfort.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Mothers possess a unique emotional ability to connect with their children, providing deep security and comfort.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Mothers are highly skilled in managing the daily routines and caregiving needs of young children.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Mothers are highly skilled in managing the daily routines and caregiving needs of young children.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Fathers are crucial because they offer a unique type of support, encouraging children to be active and exploring the world outside the home, which gives them a wide range of experiences.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Fathers are crucial because they offer a unique type of support, encouraging children to be active and exploring the world outside the home, which gives them a wide range of experiences.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Both parents have unique strengths; for example, fathers teach practical skills, while mothers provide emotional care, ensuring the child receives a balanced view of the world.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Both parents have unique strengths; for example, fathers teach practical skills, while mothers provide emotional care, ensuring the child receives a balanced view of the world.
